name: antigravity-account-manager
description: macOS Electron account manager for Google Antigravity using environment isolation and exclusive agy acp authentication
author: feiyuggg

scripts.build: npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k -n vite,electron "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5174 && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5174 electron ."
scripts.start: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron .
scripts.test:electron: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE ACP_MANAGER_SMOKE_TEST=1 electron .
